description.en: Read the manufacturer name. Register value (32-bit): 0x56455945 = ASCII "VEYE".
description.zh: 读取制造商名称。寄存器值（32位）：0x56455945 = ASCII "VEYE"。

description.en:
Read the product model code.
0x0662: GX-MIPI-IMX662, 0x0234: GX-MIPI-AR0234, 0x0664: GX-MIPI-IMX664,
0x8662: GXC-MIPI-IMX662, 0x8234: GXC-MIPI-AR0234, 0x8664: GXC-MIPI-IMX664,
0xC002: GXC-MIPI-GMAX4002CG, 0xD002: GXC-MIPI-GMAX4002MG,
0x0535: GXC-MIPI-SC535CG, 0x4535: GXC-MIPI-SC535MG,
0x0285: GXC-MIPI-SC285CR, 0x0485: GXC-MIPI-SC485CR,
0x0136: GXC-MIPI-SC136CG, 0x8136: GXC-MIPI-SC136MG, 0x0235: GXC-MIPI-SC235CR.
description.zh:
读取产品型号代码。
0x0662: GX-MIPI-IMX662, 0x0234: GX-MIPI-AR0234, 0x0664: GX-MIPI-IMX664,
0x8662: GXC-MIPI-IMX662, 0x8234: GXC-MIPI-AR0234, 0x8664: GXC-MIPI-IMX664,
0xC002: GXC-MIPI-GMAX4002CG, 0xD002: GXC-MIPI-GMAX4002MG,
0x0535: GXC-MIPI-SC535CG, 0x4535: GXC-MIPI-SC535MG,
0x0285: GXC-MIPI-SC285CR, 0x0485: GXC-MIPI-SC485CR,
0x0136: GXC-MIPI-SC136CG, 0x8136: GXC-MIPI-SC136MG, 0x0235: GXC-MIPI-SC235CR。

description.en:
Read the sensor model name.
0x662: IMX662-AAQR, 0x664: IMX664-AAQR1, 0x8234: AR0234CSSC,
0xC002: GMAX4002-AVC, 0x8535: SC535HGS-C, 0x8136: SC136HGS-C,
0x0285: SC285SL-C, 0x0485: SC485SL-C, 0x0235: SC235HAI.
description.zh:
读取传感器型号名称。
0x662: IMX662-AAQR, 0x664: IMX664-AAQR1, 0x8234: AR0234CSSC,
0xC002: GMAX4002-AVC, 0x8535: SC535HGS-C, 0x8136: SC136HGS-C,
0x0285: SC285SL-C, 0x0485: SC485SL-C, 0x0235: SC235HAI。

description.en: Read the factory serial number.
description.zh: 读取出厂序列号。

description.en: Read firmware version. High 16 bits = Control version, Low 16 bits = Logic version.
description.zh: 读取固件版本号。高16位 = 控制版本，低16位 = 逻辑版本。

description.en: Read time after system startup in milliseconds.
description.zh: 读取系统启动后的时间（毫秒）。

description.en: Read the error code register (reserved).
description.zh: 读取错误码寄存器（保留）。

description.en: Read data format capability bitmask. bit0=Mono8, bit1=Mono10, bit2=Mono12, bit4=UYVY, bit5=RGB888, bit7=YUYV.
description.zh: 读取数据格式能力位掩码。bit0=Mono8, bit1=Mono10, bit2=Mono12, bit4=UYVY, bit5=RGB888, bit7=YUYV。

description.en: Read mode capability. bit0=Normal, bit1=Binning, bit2=Subsampling.
description.zh: 读取模式能力。bit0=普通, bit1=Binning, bit2=Subsampling。

description.en: Read work/trigger mode capability. bit0=Video streaming, bit1=Normal trigger, bit3=Pulse trigger, bit4=Multi-camera sync.
description.zh: 读取工作/触发模式能力。bit0=视频流, bit1=普通触发, bit3=脉冲触发, bit4=多机同步。

description.en: Read supported MIPI lane count capability. e.g. 0x2=2 lanes, 0xA=2+4 lanes.
description.zh: 读取支持的 MIPI Lane 数量能力。如 0x2=2 lanes, 0xA=2+4 lanes。

description.en: Read resolution mode capability. Bit0=ROI mode, Bit1=Preset Mode.
description.zh: 读取分辨率模式能力。Bit0=ROI模式, Bit1=预设模式。

description.en: Read the number of supported resolution modes (up to 8).
description.zh: 读取支持的分辨率模式数量（最多8种）。

description.en: Read sensor maximum width and height.
description.zh: 读取传感器最大宽度和高度。

notes.zh: 读取两个寄存器：0x0808（宽度）和 0x080C（高度）。

description.en: Read maximum frame rate. Register value = fps * 100.
description.zh: 读取最大帧率。寄存器值 = fps * 100。

description.en: Read minimum supported ROI width and height.
description.zh: 读取最小支持的 ROI 宽度和高度。

notes.zh: 读取两个寄存器：0x0844（宽度）和 0x0848（高度）。

description.en: Read minimum frame rate. Register value = fps * 10000.
description.zh: 读取最小帧率。寄存器值 = fps * 10000。

description.en: Set/get resolution mode index [0-7] for cameras using preset resolution modes.
description.zh: 设置/获取分辨率模式索引 [0-7]，用于使用预设分辨率模式的相机。

description.en: Resolution mode index
description.zh: 分辨率模式索引

description.en: Set/get Region of Interest (x offset, y offset, width, height). Step value: 8 pixels.
description.zh: 设置/获取感兴趣区域（x 偏移, y 偏移, 宽度, 高度）。步进值：8 像素。

description.en: ROI X offset
description.zh: ROI X 偏移

description.en: ROI Y 偏移
description.zh: ROI Y 偏移

description.en: ROI width
description.zh: ROI 宽度

description.en: ROI height
description.zh: ROI 高度

description.en: Set/get frame rate in fps. Register value = fps * 10000.
description.zh: 设置/获取帧率（fps）。寄存器值 = fps * 10000。

description.en: Frame rate
description.zh: 帧率

description.en: Read resolution mode 1 resolution. Upper 16 bits = width, Lower 16 bits = height.
description.zh: 读取分辨率模式1的分辨率。高16位=宽度，低16位=高度。

description.en: Read resolution mode 1 frame rate and read mode. Mid 8 bits = read mode (0=normal,1=binning,2=subsampling), Low 16 bits = frame rate.
description.zh: 读取分辨率模式1的帧率和读取方式。中间8位=读取方式(0=普通,1=binning,2=subsampling)，低16位=帧率。

description.en: Read resolution mode 2 resolution. Upper 16 bits = width, Lower 16 bits = height.
description.zh: 读取分辨率模式2的分辨率。高16位=宽度，低16位=高度。

description.en: Read resolution mode 2 frame rate and read mode. Mid 8 bits = read mode (0=normal,1=binning,2=subsampling), Low 16 bits = frame rate.
description.zh: 读取分辨率模式2的帧率和读取方式。中间8位=读取方式(0=普通,1=binning,2=subsampling)，低16位=帧率。

description.en: Read resolution mode 3 resolution. Upper 16 bits = width, Lower 16 bits = height.
description.zh: 读取分辨率模式3的分辨率。高16位=宽度，低16位=高度。

description.en: Read resolution mode 3 frame rate and read mode. Mid 8 bits = read mode (0=normal,1=binning,2=subsampling), Low 16 bits = frame rate.
description.zh: 读取分辨率模式3的帧率和读取方式。中间8位=读取方式(0=普通,1=binning,2=subsampling)，低16位=帧率。

description.en: Read resolution mode 4 resolution. Upper 16 bits = width, Lower 16 bits = height.
description.zh: 读取分辨率模式4的分辨率。高16位=宽度，低16位=高度。

description.en: Read resolution mode 4 frame rate and read mode. Mid 8 bits = read mode (0=normal,1=binning,2=subsampling), Low 16 bits = frame rate.
description.zh: 读取分辨率模式4的帧率和读取方式。中间8位=读取方式(0=普通,1=binning,2=subsampling)，低16位=帧率。

description.en: Read resolution mode 5 resolution. Upper 16 bits = width, Lower 16 bits = height.
description.zh: 读取分辨率模式5的分辨率。高16位=宽度，低16位=高度。

description.en: Read resolution mode 5 frame rate and read mode. Mid 8 bits = read mode (0=normal,1=binning,2=subsampling), Low 16 bits = frame rate.
description.zh: 读取分辨率模式5的帧率和读取方式。中间8位=读取方式(0=普通,1=binning,2=subsampling)，低16位=帧率。

description.en: Read resolution mode 6 resolution. Upper 16 bits = width, Lower 16 bits = height.
description.zh: 读取分辨率模式6的分辨率。高16位=宽度，低16位=高度。

description.en: Read resolution mode 6 frame rate and read mode. Mid 8 bits = read mode (0=normal,1=binning,2=subsampling), Low 16 bits = frame rate.
description.zh: 读取分辨率模式6的帧率和读取方式。中间8位=读取方式(0=普通,1=binning,2=subsampling)，低16位=帧率。

description.en: Read resolution mode 7 resolution. Upper 16 bits = width, Lower 16 bits = height.
description.zh: 读取分辨率模式7的分辨率。高16位=宽度，低16位=高度。

description.en: Read resolution mode 7 frame rate and read mode. Mid 8 bits = read mode (0=normal,1=binning,2=subsampling), Low 16 bits = frame rate.
description.zh: 读取分辨率模式7的帧率和读取方式。中间8位=读取方式(0=普通,1=binning,2=subsampling)，低16位=帧率。

description.en: Read resolution mode 8 resolution. Upper 16 bits = width, Lower 16 bits = height.
description.zh: 读取分辨率模式8的分辨率。高16位=宽度，低16位=高度。

description.en: Read resolution mode 8 frame rate and read mode. Mid 8 bits = read mode (0=normal,1=binning,2=subsampling), Low 16 bits = frame rate.
description.zh: 读取分辨率模式8的帧率和读取方式。中间8位=读取方式(0=普通,1=binning,2=subsampling)，低16位=帧率。

description.en: Read current ROI width and height. Registers 0x0818/0x081C are RW in ROI mode.
description.zh: 读取当前 ROI 宽度和高度。寄存器 0x0818/0x081C 在 ROI 模式下可读写。

notes.en: Reads two registers: 0x0818 (ROI Width) and 0x081C (ROI Height).
notes.zh: 读取两个寄存器：0x0818（ROI 宽度）和 0x081C（ROI 高度）。

description.en: Read MIPI data rate per lane in kbps.
description.zh: 读取每 Lane 的 MIPI 数据率（kbps）。

description.en: Read current frame rate. Register value = fps * 10000.
description.zh: 读取当前帧率。寄存器值 = fps * 10000。

description.en: Read current read mode. 0=Normal, 1=2x2 Binning, 2=Subsampling.
description.zh: 读取当前读取模式。0=普通, 1=2x2 Binning, 2=Subsampling。

description.en: Read current MIPI lane count (2 or 4).
description.zh: 读取当前 MIPI Lane 数量（2 或 4）。

description.en: Read sensor and output frame counts.
description.zh: 读取传感器帧计数和输出帧计数。

notes.zh: 读取两个寄存器：0x0464（传感器）和 0x0468（输出）。

description.en: Read sensor junction temperature in Kelvin. Register value = Kelvin * 100.
description.zh: 读取传感器结温（开尔文）。寄存器值 = 开尔文 * 100。

description.en: Read ISP chip junction temperature in Kelvin. Register value = Kelvin * 100.
description.zh: 读取 ISP 芯片结温（开尔文）。寄存器值 = 开尔文 * 100。

description.en: Read current exposure time in microseconds.
description.zh: 读取当前曝光时间（微秒）。

description.en: Read current gain value. Register value = dB * 10.
description.zh: 读取当前增益值。寄存器值 = dB * 10。

description.en: Read current ISO value.
description.zh: 读取当前 ISO 值。

description.en: Set/get exposure mode. 0=Manual, 2=Auto.
description.zh: 设置/获取曝光模式。0=手动, 2=自动。

description.en: Exposure mode
description.zh: 曝光模式

description.en: Set/get target brightness for auto exposure. Range [0, 255].
description.zh: 设置/获取自动曝光目标亮度。范围 [0, 255]。

description.en: Target brightness
description.zh: 目标亮度

description.en: Set/get auto exposure strategy. 0=Highlight priority, 1=Shadow priority (Backlight Compensation).
description.zh: 设置/获取自动曝光策略。0=高亮优先, 1=暗区优先（逆光补偿）。

description.en: AE strategy
description.zh: AE策略

description.en: Set/get maximum exposure time in auto exposure mode. Range [16, 1000000] us.
description.zh: 设置/获取自动曝光模式下的最大曝光时间。范围 [16, 1000000] 微秒。

description.en: Max exposure time
description.zh: 最大曝光时间

description.en: Set/get minimum exposure time in auto exposure mode. Range [16, 1000000] us.
description.zh: 设置/获取自动曝光模式下的最小曝光时间。范围 [16, 1000000] 微秒。

description.en: Min exposure time
description.zh: 最小曝光时间

description.en: Set/get maximum gain in auto exposure mode. Register value = dB * 10.
description.zh: 设置/获取自动曝光模式下的最大增益。寄存器值 = dB * 10。

description.en: Max gain value
description.zh: 最大增益值

description.en: Set/get manual exposure time in microseconds. Range [16, 1000000]. Only effective in manual mode.
description.zh: 设置/获取手动曝光时间（微秒）。范围 [16, 1000000]。仅在手动模式下生效。

description.en: Exposure time
description.zh: 曝光时间

notes.en: Unit: microseconds. Note: actual sensor precision is 1 line.
notes.zh: 单位：微秒。注意：传感器实际精度为 1 line。

description.en: Set/get manual gain value. Register value = dB * 10. Only effective in manual gain mode (expmode=0).
description.zh: 设置/获取手动增益值。寄存器值 = dB * 10。仅在手动增益模式（expmode=0）下生效。

description.en: Gain value
description.zh: 增益值

notes.en: Register value is 10x the actual dB value. Range and step vary by sensor model.
notes.zh: 寄存器值为实际 dB 值的 10 倍。范围和步进因型号而异。

description.en: Set/get anti-flicker enable and frequency. Enable: 0=off, 1=on. Frequency: 50 or 60 Hz.
description.zh: 设置/获取防闪烁使能和频率。使能：0=关, 1=开。频率：50 或 60 Hz。

description.en: Anti-flicker enable
description.zh: 防闪烁使能

description.en: Anti-flicker frequency
description.zh: 防闪烁频率

notes.zh: 写入两个寄存器：0x0C94（使能）和 0x0C98（频率）。

description.en: Set/get slow shutter enable and gain threshold. Only effective in auto exposure + video stream mode. Gain threshold unit: 0.1 dB.
description.zh: 设置/获取慢快门使能和增益阈值。仅在自动曝光 + 视频流模式下生效。增益阈值单位：0.1 dB。

description.en: Slow shutter enable
description.zh: 慢快门使能

description.en: Gain threshold for auto frame reduction
description.zh: 自动降帧增益阈值

notes.en: Writes two registers: 0x0CBC (enable) and 0x0CC0 (gain threshold * 10). When using slow shutter, set aemaxtime=1000000 first.
notes.zh: 写入两个寄存器：0x0CBC（使能）和 0x0CC0（增益阈值 * 10）。使用慢快门时需先设置 aemaxtime=1000000。

description.en: Set/get AE region weighting. 0=Center-priority, 1=Bottom-priority, 2=Top-priority.
description.zh: 设置/获取 AE 区域权重。0=中心优先, 1=底部优先, 2=顶部优先。

description.en: AE weight mode
description.zh: AE 权重模式

description.en: Read current color temperature in Kelvin.
description.zh: 读取当前色温（开尔文）。

description.en: Read current white balance R gain [0, 4095].
description.zh: 读取当前白平衡 R 增益 [0, 4095]。

description.en: Read current white balance B gain [0, 4095].
description.zh: 读取当前白平衡 B 增益 [0, 4095]。

description.en: Set/get white balance mode. 0=Manual, 2=Auto.
description.zh: 设置/获取白平衡模式。0=手动, 2=自动。

description.en: WB mode
description.zh: 白平衡模式

description.en: Set/get minimum color temperature for auto white balance. Range [1000, 15000] K.
description.zh: 设置/获取自动白平衡最小色温。范围 [1000, 15000] K。

description.en: Min color temperature
description.zh: 最小色温

description.en: Set/get maximum color temperature for auto white balance. Range [1000, 15000] K.
description.zh: 设置/获取自动白平衡最大色温。范围 [1000, 15000] K。

description.en: Max color temperature
description.zh: 最大色温

name.zh: 手动白平衡 R 增益

description.en: Set/get manual white balance R gain. Range [0, 4095].
description.zh: 设置/获取手动白平衡 R 增益。范围 [0, 4095]。

description.en: R gain value
description.zh: R 增益值

name.zh: 手动白平衡 B 增益

description.en: Set/get manual white balance B gain. Range [0, 4095].
description.zh: 设置/获取手动白平衡 B 增益。范围 [0, 4095]。

description.en: B gain value
description.zh: B 增益值

description.en: Set/get gamma preset. 0=Off(Linear), 1=Default, 2=Gamma1.6, 3=Gamma1.8, 4=Gamma2.0, 5=Gamma2.2, 6-11=Style1-6, 12=User-defined.
description.zh: 设置/获取 Gamma 预设。0=关闭(线性), 1=默认, 2=Gamma1.6, 3=Gamma1.8, 4=Gamma2.0, 5=Gamma2.2, 6-11=风格1-6, 12=用户自定义。

description.en: Gamma preset index
description.zh: Gamma 预设索引

description.en: Set/get sharpening strength. Range [0, 255].
description.zh: 设置/获取锐化强度。范围 [0, 255]。

description.en: Sharpening strength
description.zh: 锐化强度

description.en: Set/get 2D noise reduction strength. Range [0, 255].
description.zh: 设置/获取 2D 降噪强度。范围 [0, 255]。

description.en: 2D denoise strength
description.zh: 2D 降噪强度

description.en: Set/get 3D noise reduction strength. Range [0, 255].
description.zh: 设置/获取 3D 降噪强度。范围 [0, 255]。

description.en: 3D denoise strength
description.zh: 3D 降噪强度

description.en: Set/get saturation. Range [0, 100].
description.zh: 设置/获取饱和度。范围 [0, 100]。

description.en: Saturation value
description.zh: 饱和度值

description.en: Set/get contrast. Range [0, 100].
description.zh: 设置/获取对比度。范围 [0, 100]。

description.en: Contrast value
description.zh: 对比度值

description.en: Set/get hue. Range [0, 100].
description.zh: 设置/获取色调。范围 [0, 100]。

description.en: Hue value
description.zh: 色调值

description.en: Set/get LDC strength. Range [0, 255], 0=disable. Must be set before image acquisition to take effect.
description.zh: 设置/获取 LDC 强度。范围 [0, 255]，0=禁用。需在相机采集图像前设置才能生效。

description.en: LDC strength
description.zh: LDC 强度

description.en: Set/get LSC (Mesh Lens Shading Correction) strength. Range [0, 255], 0=disable, 128=default.
description.zh: 设置/获取 LSC（Mesh 镜头阴影校正）强度。范围 [0, 255]，0=禁用，128=默认。

description.en: LSC strength
description.zh: LSC 强度

description.en: Set/get dehaze (defogging) strength. Range [0, 255], 0=off.
description.zh: 设置/获取去雾强度。范围 [0, 255]，0=关闭。

description.en: Dehaze strength
description.zh: 去雾强度

description.en: Set/get digital wide dynamic range (DRC) strength. Range [0, 255], 0=off.
description.zh: 设置/获取数字宽动态范围（DRC）强度。范围 [0, 255]，0=关闭。

description.en: DRC strength
description.zh: DRC 强度

description.en: Set/get WDR option and strength. Option: 0=Disable, 1=Digital WDR, 2=DOL WDR, 3=Clear WDR. Strength: [0, 255].
description.zh: 设置/获取 WDR 选项和强度。选项：0=禁用, 1=数字WDR, 2=DOL WDR, 3=清晰WDR。强度：[0, 255]。

description.en: WDR option
description.zh: WDR 选项

description.en: WDR strength
description.zh: WDR 强度

notes.zh: 写入两个寄存器：0x0C9C（选项）和 0x0CA0（强度）。

description.en: Set/get custom scene selection. When bit 15 = 1, custom scene mode is enabled; otherwise auto selection.
description.zh: 设置/获取自定义场景选择。当 bit 15 = 1 时启用自定义场景模式，否则自动选择。

description.en: Custom scene value
description.zh: 自定义场景值

description.en: Set/get work mode. 0=Video streaming, 1=Trigger, 3=Pulse trigger (hardware only), 4=Multi-camera sync. Requires stopping acquisition first.
description.zh: 设置/获取工作模式。0=视频流, 1=触发, 3=脉冲触发(仅硬件), 4=多机同步。需先停止采集。

description.en: Work mode
description.zh: 工作模式

description.en: Set/get trigger source. 0=Software trigger, 1=Hardware trigger. Effective in Work Mode 1 and 3 only.
description.zh: 设置/获取触发源。0=软触发, 1=硬触发。仅在工作模式 1 和 3 下生效。

description.en: Trigger source
description.zh: 触发源

description.en: Set/get number of trigger frames per trigger event. Range [1, 255], default 1.
description.zh: 设置/获取每次触发的帧数。范围 [1, 255]，默认 1。

description.en: Trigger frame count
description.zh: 触发帧数

description.en: Set/get trigger interval in microseconds. Range [0, 0x00FFFFFF].
description.zh: 设置/获取触发间隔（微秒）。范围 [0, 0x00FFFFFF]。

description.en: Trigger interval
description.zh: 触发间隔

description.en: Write 1 to trigger one frame capture. No parameters needed.
description.zh: 写 1 触发一帧采集。无需参数。

description.en: Read trigger statistics (success/lost counts). Write 1 to clear count.
description.zh: 读取触发统计（成功/丢失计数）。写 1 清除计数。

description.en: Write 1 to clear
description.zh: 写 1 清除

description.en: Set/get trigger edge polarity. 0=Rising edge, 1=Falling edge.
description.zh: 设置/获取触发边沿极性。0=上升沿, 1=下降沿。

description.en: Trigger edge
description.zh: 触发边沿

description.en: Set/get trigger delay in microseconds. Range [0, 1000000]. Effective in both soft and hard trigger modes.
description.zh: 设置/获取触发延迟（微秒）。范围 [0, 1000000]。在软触发和硬触发模式下均生效。

description.en: Trigger delay
description.zh: 触发延迟

description.en: Set/get exposure delay (strobe advance time) in microseconds. Range [0, 1000000].
description.zh: 设置/获取曝光延迟（闪光灯提前时间）（微秒）。范围 [0, 1000000]。

description.en: Exposure delay
description.zh: 曝光延迟

description.en: Set/get master/slave role in multi-camera sync mode. 0=Main Mode, 1=Slave Mode.
description.zh: 设置/获取多机同步模式下的主从角色。0=主机模式, 1=从机模式。

description.en: Master/Slave role
description.zh: 主从角色

description.en: Read minimum trigger signal period in microseconds.
description.zh: 读取最小触发信号周期（微秒）。

description.en: Set/get day/night mode. 0=Color, 1=B&W, 2=External Trigger.
description.zh: 设置/获取日夜模式。0=彩色, 1=黑白, 2=外部触发。

description.en: Day/Night mode
description.zh: 日夜模式

description.en: Set/get IRCUT direction reversal.
description.zh: 设置/获取 IRCUT 方向反转。

description.en: IRCUT direction
description.zh: IRCUT 方向

description.en: Set/get day/night trigger pin polarity. Default: low level = night. Set 1: high level = night.
description.zh: 设置/获取日夜触发引脚极性。默认：低电平=夜间。设为 1：高电平=夜间。

description.en: Pin polarity
description.zh: 引脚极性

description.en: Set/get IRCUT periodic control enable. When enabled, IRCUT switches periodically.
description.zh: 设置/获取 IRCUT 周期控制使能。启用后 IRCUT 按周期切换。

description.en: IRCUT timer enable
description.zh: IRCUT 定时器使能

description.en: Set/get GPIO1 output select. 0=Strobe, 1=UserOut, 2=TriggerWait (busy inverse).
description.zh: 设置/获取 GPIO1 输出选择。0=Strobe, 1=UserOut, 2=TriggerWait（busy 反相）。

description.en: GPIO1 output mode
description.zh: GPIO1 输出模式

description.en: Set/get GPIO1 signal reversal.
description.zh: 设置/获取 GPIO1 信号反转。

description.en: Signal reverse
description.zh: 信号反转

description.en: Set/get test image selector. 0=Off, 1=Vertical color bars.
description.zh: 设置/获取测试图像选择。0=关闭, 1=竖彩色条纹。

description.en: Test image selector
description.zh: 测试图像选择

description.en: Set/get pixel format. 0=Mono8, 1=Mono10, 2=Mono12, 4=UYVY, 5=RGB888, 7=YUYV. Requires stopping acquisition.
description.zh: 设置/获取像素格式。0=Mono8, 1=Mono10, 2=Mono12, 4=UYVY, 5=RGB888, 7=YUYV。需停止采集。

description.en: Pixel format
description.zh: 像素格式

description.en: Set/get image orientation. 0=Normal, 1=Mirror, 2=Flip, 3=Flip+Mirror.
description.zh: 设置/获取图像方向。0=正常, 1=镜像, 2=翻转, 3=翻转+镜像。

description.en: Image direction
description.zh: 图像方向

description.en: Set/get MIPI clock mode. 0=Discontinuous, 1=Continuous.
description.zh: 设置/获取 MIPI 时钟模式。0=非连续, 1=连续。

description.en: Clock mode
description.zh: 时钟模式

description.en: Set/get metadata mode. 0=Disabled, 1=Overlay on image (last 64 Y pixels), 2=Footer Row Metadata (2 extra lines), 3=Embedded Line.
description.zh: 设置/获取元数据模式。0=禁用, 1=叠加在图像上(最后64行Y像素), 2=底行元数据(追加2行), 3=嵌入式行。

description.en: Metadata mode
description.zh: 元数据模式

description.en: Start/stop image acquisition. 0=Stop, 1=Start.
description.zh: 启动/停止图像采集。0=停止, 1=启动。

description.en: Image acquisition
description.zh: 图像采集

description.en: Restore all parameters to factory defaults. WARNING: This erases flash and rewrites. Do not interrupt power.
description.zh: 恢复所有参数为出厂默认值。警告：此操作将擦除 Flash 并重写，请勿断电。

description.en: Save all parameters to flash (non-volatile). WARNING: Do not interrupt power during operation.
description.zh: 将所有参数保存到 Flash（非易失）。警告：操作过程中请勿断电。

description.en: Reboot the camera system. WARNING: Active configuration will be lost if not saved.
description.zh: 重启相机系统。警告：如未保存，当前配置将丢失。

description.en: Set/get I2C address. Range [0x03, 0x77]. WARNING: Incorrect address will cause communication loss.
description.zh: 设置/获取 I2C 地址。范围 [0x03, 0x77]。警告：错误地址将导致通信丢失。

description.en: I2C address (hex)
description.zh: I2C 地址（十六进制）

notes.en: Default address is 0x3b. Changing to invalid address will cause communication loss.
notes.zh: 默认地址为 0x3b。更改为无效地址将导致通信丢失。

description.en: Set/get MIPI repeater register. Bit[0-3]=EQ[0-3], Bit[8-10]=ERC[0-3], Bit[16-19]=Output Pre-emphasis & Swing[0-3].
description.zh: 设置/获取 MIPI 中继寄存器。Bit[0-3]=EQ[0-3], Bit[8-10]=ERC[0-3], Bit[16-19]=输出预加重&摆幅[0-3]。

description.en: ReDriver register value
description.zh: ReDriver 寄存器值

description.en: Read a raw sensor register value directly. Requires sensor register address parameter.
description.zh: 直接读取传感器原始寄存器值。需要传感器寄存器地址参数。

description.en: Sensor register address (hex)
description.zh: 传感器寄存器地址（十六进制）
